title: Keine Notizen zu Nightscout in Android APS
symptom: The user reports that notes entered in AAPS under the carbohydrates button are not transferred to Nightscout. The notes appear in treatments/user input in AAPS but do not arrive in Nightscout.
fix: The maintainer tested with dev version and Nightscout 14.2.6 and found notes are visible on Nightscout when hovering over entries. The user later closed the issue after trying Nightscout 15.0.0 and AAPS 3.1.0.3, but no definitive fix was stated.
evidence_quote: I just tested the behaviour with the dev 2022.12.15 and Nightscout version 14.2.6. Everything is working as intended - notes are visible on Nightscout - a bit hidden thought. Notes are only visible if you **hover over the entries**.
